question: ¿Qué volumen de petróleo de 2025, en m³, es de YPF si se reparte la producción de cada concesión entre sus socios según su porcentaje?

attempts.query:
WITH socios AS ( SELECT c.id_concesion, trim(split_part(p, ':', 1)) AS empresa, replace(trim(regexp_replace(split_part(p, ':', 2), '[^0-9.,]', '', 'g')), ',', '.')::numeric AS pct FROM sig_energia.concesion c, LATERAL regexp_split_to_table(c.participacion, '
') AS p WHERE p LIKE '%:%' AND regexp_replace(split_part(p, ':', 2), '[^0-9.,]', '', 'g') <> '' ), ypf AS ( SELECT id_concesion, sum(pct) AS pct FROM socios WHERE upper(empresa) ~ '^YPF\M' GROUP BY id_concesion ), prod AS ( SELECT idareapermisoconcesion AS id, sum(prod_pet) AS pet FROM capitulo4.produccion WHERE anio = 2025 GROUP BY idareapermisoconcesion ) SELECT round(sum(prod.pet * ypf.pct / 100), 0) AS volumen_ypf FROM prod JOIN ypf ON ypf.id_concesion = prod.id
